# REDIS\_INIT\_ERROR variable

Message of the `TypeError` thrown by every cache operation when no redis connection is available — either `RedisCache.init()` was never awaited, or [TagCache.destroy()](/api/tag-cache/latest/tag-cache.tagcache.destroy/) has already been called on this instance.

**Signature:**

```typescript
REDIS_INIT_ERROR = "Redis engine is not initialized!"
```
